title: Work Intake Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/node_shaping_audit.mjs — one operator WorkIntent's signal vector, the topology archetype(s) it resolved to, and the legacy launch verbs reachable from its entrypoint.

id.description: Stable identifier for the operator WorkIntent being shaped.

coupling.description: How tightly the sub-steps of this work depend on each other's live output.

contextPressure.description: How much accumulated context the work needs to carry forward as it proceeds.

skillBoundary.description: How many distinct skill domains the work spans.

reviewIndependence.description: Whether the work's outputs need a reviewer separate from the agent(s) producing them.

budget.description: Cost/time envelope the operator is willing to commit before checking in.

operatorBurden.description: How much steering/attention the operator expects to give while the work runs.

selectedArchetypes.description: The topology archetype(s) this WorkIntent resolved to. A safe spec has exactly one entry from the canonical seven (node, scout, chain, dag-workgroup, tournament, ambient-watcher, human-gate).

legacyRoutes.description: Legacy launch verbs (spawn, dispatch, sortie, conjure, nightshift) reachable from this WorkIntent's entrypoint, and whether each one independently writes Agent Node/session/transcript state.

writesIndependentState.description: True if this verb's compatibility shim opens its own Agent Node/session/transcript instead of routing into the shared WorkPlan pipeline. Must be false for every route in a safe spec.
